exercises.question: Find the remainder when P(x) = x³ - 2x² + 5 is divided by x - 2.
exercises.question_amharic: ፖሊኖሚያል P(x) = x³ - 2x² + 5 ለ x - 2 ሲካፈል የሚተርፈውን ቀሪ ፈልጉ።
exercises.step_by_step_explanation: 1. Identify c = 2 from x - 2.\n2. Evaluate P(2) = (2)³ - 2(2)² + 5.\n3. P(2) = 8 - 8 + 5 = 5.
exercises.step_by_step_explanation_amharic: 1. Identify c = 2 from x - 2.\n2. Evaluate P(2) = (2)³ - 2(2)² + 5.\n3. P(2) = 8 - 8 + 5 = 5.
exercises.formula_or_working: Remainder Theorem: Remainder = P(c) when divided by x - c.
